protocol.readMethod: infinite scroll to saturation then Load more results to exhaustion

retrievalLimitation: Only the first 25 of 44 render. The "Load more results" control that exhausts the 4-star listing does not appear here, and the offset query parameter is ignored (a second navigation with offset=25 returned the identical first 25 properties).
volatilityNote: Two properties moved between reads minutes apart (222->215, 243->258, about 3-6%). The median was unchanged at 273 in both reads.
